北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴空万里，气温 30℃，记得多喝水防晒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Beijing, 30℃. Remember to hydrate and protect from the sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天 30℃，体感闷热，注意防暑降温哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast 30℃, feeling muggy. Stay cool and prevent heatstroke.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 32℃ 多云，体感炎热，出行注意防晒防暑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai 32℃ partly cloudy, feels hot. Remember sun and heat protection!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿 30℃，注意保持清爽，防潮防暑。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and humid 30℃. Stay cool, prevent dampness and heatstroke.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 27℃ 阴天，湿度 76%，感觉黏腻，注意防潮哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen 27℃ overcast, 76% humidity. Feels sticky, mind the dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 31℃ 多云，午后小心紫外线，及时补水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou 31℃ partly cloudy. Watch out for UV in the afternoon, rehydrate promptly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天 31℃，风力 4 级，出门注意防风，小心着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast 31℃, wind force 4. Mind the wind outside, avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 28℃，体感舒适，记得带伞以防阵雨。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast 28℃, feels pleasant. Remember an umbrella for possible showers.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天 29℃，湿度 50%，注意防晒补水，保持好心情。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast 29℃, 50% humidity. Hydrate and sun protect, keep a good mood.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 32℃ 多云，体感燥热，防晒多饮水，注意防暑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an 32℃ partly cloudy, feels dry and hot. Sun protect, drink water, prevent heatstroke.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 23℃ 有雾，湿度 83%，开车注意能见度，小心慢行。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing 23℃ foggy, 83% humidity. Drivers watch visibility, drive carefully.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨

哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin 25℃ overcast, wind force 4. Feels cool, dress appropriately when going out.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴空 27℃，风力 4 级，外出注意防风，享受阳光。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny 27℃, wind force 4. Mind the wind outside, enjoy the sunshine.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 18℃，体感凉爽，雨具常备，注意保暖。

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 26℃，风力 4 级，出门小心大风，注意添衣哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen 26℃ overcast, wind force 4. Watch out for strong winds, add clothes.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛 24℃ 多云，风力 4 级，海边风大，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao 24℃ partly cloudy, wind force 4. Windy by the sea, avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天 25℃，风力 4 级，海边风大，记得带件外套哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny 25℃, wind force 4. Windy by the sea, remember a jacket.
